title: Vision-Language-Action Models: A Life-Cycle Survey of Design, Training and Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2611.18372v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt web-pretrained vision-language models to output robot actions, so that web knowledge carries over to physical control. In under 4 years the field has moved from RT-2, the first VLA, to open models that fine-tune on a single consumer GPU and to proprietary generalists that clean unseen homes. This survey reviews 88 works from December 2022 to October 2026, mainly on manipulation and navigation, plus humanoid control, world-action models and evaluation. We follow a VLA through its life cycle, from model design to training and deployment, along seven axes. Model design covers (a) inputs and memory, what the model observes; (b) architecture, how its pipeline is built; (c) action output, how it produces motor commands; and (d) intermediate predictions, what else it predicts, from reasoning steps to future observations. Training covers (e) pretraining data, the mix of robot, web, human and simulated

translated_title: 视觉-语言-动作模型：设计、训练与部署的全生命周期综述
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将网络预训练的视觉-语言模型适配为输出机器人动作，从而使网络知识得以迁移到物理控制中。在不到4年的时间里，该领域从首个VLA模型RT-2，发展到可在单张消费级GPU上微调的开源模型，再到能够清扫陌生住宅的专有通用模型。本综述回顾了2022年12月至2026年10月间的88项研究工作，主要聚焦于机器人操作与导航，并涵盖人形机器人控制、世界-动作模型与评估。我们沿着七个维度追踪VLA从模型设计到训练与部署的全生命周期：模型设计涵盖，输入与记忆，即模型观察什么；架构，即其流水线如何构建；动作输出，即它如何产生运动指令；中间预测，即它还预测什么，从推理步骤到未来观测。训练涵盖——预训练数据，即机器人、网络、人类与仿真数据的混合（注：原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 这是一篇系统性综述，沿着模型设计（输入与记忆、架构、动作输出、中间预测）、训练（预训练数据等）与部署的全生命周期七个维度，梳理了2022至2026年间88项视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型研究，覆盖操作、导航、人形控制与世界-动作模型等方向。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews 88 vision-language-action (VLA) model works from December 2022 to October 2026, following their life cycle along seven axes spanning model design, training, and deployment.
